# Tailrocks: Retrospect

`tailrocks-retrospect` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-retrospect)

After a roadmap item ships, rebuild which skills ran from commit trailers, diff that against its Decisions, Must not, spec IDs, and verification rounds, and propose patches to the skills at fault. Proposes only; tailrocks-skill-update edits skills.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-retrospect` …

Arguments: `<roadmap-slug> [--source <path>] [--repo <owner/name>] [--pr <number>]`

file. They are not copied here — one source, and no chance of the two drifting.
